$description: Beatham core colour rules, enforced for core and every sub-brand by brand/scripts/check-roles.mjs (part of `npm run brand:check`). A sub-brand may add grants (subbrand.json → rules.grants), each with a scope and a reason; it may never loosen the rules below. See docs/BRAND.md.

accent.$description: The accent rule: the accent marks only what you act on — selection, focus, the active control. The sub-brand's accent ramp (subbrand.json → palettes.accent, default brand) may appear in these roles and nowhere else; these roles may use only the accent ramp or neutral.

ramps.$description: Which core roles each core ramp may fill. neutral may fill any role. A ramp not listed here (or listed with no roles) fills no core role until a sub-brand grants it.

never.$description: Never in any semantic role, core or sub-brand: these are palette and marketing colours (illustration, packaging, previews).

hueBudget.$description: Distinct non-neutral hues (ramps) that chrome roles may use, not counting the accent. Chrome = core roles + grants with scope "chrome". Scoped grants (analysis, data, category, physical, mark) are budgeted separately: each needs a reason and a legend or label wherever it appears.

proportion.$description: Every sub-brand declares a proportion system: what share of a typical screen (or part, or page) each colour covers. Parts must sum to 100. The core default is 90 / 7 / 3 — neutral / accent / signals.
